name: Shiisa Ayo
bio:
I am Shiisa Ayo, a positive-minded woman born between Africa's two iconic peaks, Mount Meru and Mount Kilimanjaro. Growing up in this inspiring region motivated me to pursue a career in tourism and hospitality. I earned my first degree in Tourism and Cultural Heritage from the University of Dodoma, and now I work with Mazingira Eco-Friendly Safari as a tour consultant specializing in sales and reservations.
Passionate about my job, I wear a smile most of the time. I love exploring national parks, and in my free time, I cherish moments with my beloved son while learning new things through movies, reading books, or engaging on social media.
